# 0005. API alerts are SLO burn rates generated by Sloth

Status: accepted

## Context

Fixed thresholds such as "5xx above 5% for ten minutes" page for short spikes
that users barely notice and stay silent for slow, steady failures.

## Decision

The API has availability and latency objectives over 30 days, defined as a
Sloth `PrometheusServiceLevel` in the runtime chart. Sloth generates the
recording rules and multi-window burn-rate alerts: a page for fast burns, a
ticket for slow ones.

## Consequences

Alerts follow user impact and stay quiet when the error budget is healthy.
Objectives are chart values, stricter in production. Sloth's CRD must exist
before the runtime chart syncs, so Sloth runs in an earlier wave.
